title: Nightly TicWatch Pro / MM2 / Pixel 2 XL Android 10 issues after install
symptom: After installing the 21st Jan nightly, the TicWatch Pro is pretty much unusable: incredibly slow response to screen presses, connects to MM2 but drops connections after first reading, screen goes blank and requires button presses to show data. Also, with the 31st Dec release, if Force Wear Collection Service is not set, connection issues occur after 6-8 hours.
cause: The issue was caused by not uninstalling the previous version before installing the new nightly; an in-place upgrade caused problems. The user read that it is advised to uninstall on phone and watch for each release.
fix: Uninstall the previous version from the phone and watch, then install the new nightly cleanly. After doing this, the 21st Jan nightly worked well, with only one disconnect overnight.
evidence_quote: realised not uninstalled on my phone before installing the new nightly (think I read that its advised to uninstall on phone and watch for each release). Once it was installed cleanly - the 21st Jan nightly is working well
